Ledyard National Bank Has Cut Stake in Apple (AAPL) by $537,758; Apple (AAPL) Position Held by Pineno Levin & Ford Asset Management Inc
May 7, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Ledyard National Bank decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 2.09% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Ledyard National Bank sold 3,182 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 148,875 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $25.19M, down from 152,057 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Ledyard National Bank who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $932.76B market cap company. The stock increased 3.92% or $6.94 during the last trading session, reaching $183.83. About 53.48 million shares traded or 45.42% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since May 7, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.

It also increased its holding in Ishares Msci Eafe Index Etf (EFA) by 11,789 shares in the quarter, for a total of 87,776 shares, and has risen its stake in Sanofi Adr (NYSE:SNY).
